intro: Free to play. No whitelist, no application. Just join.

java.title: Java Edition (PC)
steps: Enter the address **{javaIp}** and click Done.
Accept the **resource pack** and wait. The first download can take up to about 5 minutes. Don't cancel it.

bedrock.title: Bedrock Edition (console, mobile, Windows)
steps: Go to **Social**, at the top right.
Search for **EuphoriaHQ7845** and add them as a friend.
Accept the **resource pack** and wait. The first download can take up to about 3 minutes. Don't cancel it.
bedrock.note: Bedrock players join through our friend account instead of typing in an address. Ask in our Discord if you need help joining.

gettingStarted.title: 1. Pick your race
gettingStarted.body: The race menu opens the first time you join, and you can't play until you choose. Four races are free. **Your race is permanent**, so choose with care.

gettingStarted.title: 2. Get a job
gettingStarted.body: Jobs are the main way to earn money. You join each one at its own NPC in the spawn world.

gettingStarted.title: 3. Claim your land
gettingStarted.body: You start with 1 claim and 10 chunks. Find a spot in the playworld and claim it so nobody else can build there.

gettingStarted.title: 4. Link your Discord
gettingStarted.body: Run /link in game, send the code to the BrindleWood bot in a direct message, and get a free diamond.

introSub: Works on Java and Bedrock, Minecraft 26.2 and above.

trouble.title: Version mismatch or can't connect
trouble.body: Update Minecraft to 26.2 or newer, then try again. Java players should also double check the address.

trouble.title: Resource pack looks stuck
trouble.body: Wait. The first download takes up to about 5 minutes on Java and 3 on Bedrock, and cancelling it means you can't play.

trouble.title: Can't find the Bedrock friend
trouble.body: Type the name exactly: EuphoriaHQ7845. Still nothing? Ask in our Discord.
